keys.intent: she greets the player at the start of a day

lines: She circles once and folds down, already half-asleep.
She stretches out and lets her eyes close.

keys.speaker: player
keys.intent: the player studies her and notes a change

lines: New colour at the edges. Gradual, but real.
She's more animal than last time. She knows it too.
She breathes, and takes it in.

keys.speaker: subject
keys.intent: she inspects herself in the mirror

lines: She turns slowly, drinking herself in. "More. Look at me."
She looks herself over. "Still me. For now."
She studies her reflection, tilting her head.

keys.speaker: subject
keys.intent: she asks the player to stop

lines: Stop. Stop, please, I mean it.
Wait. Give me a second. Stop.

keys.speaker: subject
keys.intent: she panics against a hard limit

lines: No — no, not that. Get it away from me.
Her eyes roll back and she goes limp.

keys.speaker: subject

lines: The last of the words drains out of her. Something else looks out.
